golang.go: official Go extension: completion (gopls), debugging, tests.
rust-lang.rust-analyzer: Rust language server: analysis, completion, hints. Heavy.
serayuzgur.crates: suggests current dependency versions in Cargo.toml.
ms-azuretools.vscode-docker: Docker support: images, containers, Dockerfile, compose.
ms-kubernetes-tools.vscode-kubernetes-to: manage Kubernetes clusters from the editor.
ms-toolsai.jupyter: Jupyter notebooks in VS Code: cells, output, kernels.
ms-toolsai.datawrangler: view and clean tabular data (Data Wrangler).
ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh: develop on a remote machine over SSH.
ms-vscode-remote.remote-wsl: develop inside WSL as if it were local.
humao.rest-client: send HTTP requests right from .http files.
rangav.vscode-thunder-client: GUI client for REST requests (like Postman).
redhat.vscode-yaml: YAML support with schemas and completion.
tamasfe.even-better-toml: highlighting and validation for TOML files.
ms-dotnettools.csdevkit: C# Dev Kit: projects, tests, IntelliCode. Heavy.
shopify.ruby-lsp: Ruby language server: analysis, completion, formatting.
sumneko.lua: Lua language server: diagnostics and completion.
hashicorp.terraform: highlighting, completion and validation for Terraform (HCL).
astro-build.astro-vscode: support for the Astro framework (.astro files).
graphql.vscode-graphql: completion and validation for GraphQL queries and schemas.
catppuccin.catppuccin-vsc: active color theme (Catppuccin Mocha, #1e1e2e). Switch variant: Ctrl+K Ctrl+T.
brandonkirbyson.vscode-animations: cursor, tab and panel animations. Loaded via custom-css. Settings: Ctrl+Shift+P → Animations.
be5invis.vscode-custom-css: Custom CSS/JS Loader, the core of the cosmetics. Commands: Enable/Disable/Reload Custom CSS and JS. File list is in vscode_custom_css.imports.
ms-vscode.cpptools-themes: C/C++ highlighting theme (Dark+). Installed with cpptools.
aaron-bond.better-comments: colors comments by tag (!, ?, TODO, *). Configured in settings.json.
anthropic.claude-code: Claude Code in VS Code: chat panel plus agent. Ctrl+Shift+P → Claude.
ms-azuretools.vscode-azure-github-copilo: Copilot for Azure (@azure in chat). Needs a GitHub login.
ms-windows-ai-studio.windows-ai-studio: Foundry Toolkit: local and cloud models, playground.
ms-azuretools.vscode-azure-mcp-server: MCP server for Azure (tools for AI agents).
sonarsource.sonarlint-vscode: quality/security linter (plus AI hints). Highlights bugs as you type.
amiralizadeh9480.cpp-helper: generates .cpp from .h, include guards. Ctrl+Shift+P → C++ Helper.
franneck94.c-cpp-runner: build and run C/C++ without manual config. Buttons in the status bar.
twxs.cmake: CMakeLists.txt highlighting. Outdated and unmaintained: CMake Tools highlights CMake itself — safe to remove.
xaver.clang-format: formatting via clang-format (LLVM). Set up to format on save.
nicolascapel.sfml: SFML snippets and support (graphics/games in C++).
cesium.gltf-vscode: preview and validation of glTF models (3D).
donjayamanne.python-extension-pack: pack (Django, Jinja, IntelliSense…). The env manager was removed from it earlier.
njpwerner.autodocstring: generates a docstring from the signature (""" + Enter).
vscjava.vscode-java-pack: the main pack (pulls in everything below).
formulahendry.auto-rename-tag: renames the paired HTML tag automatically.
ritwickdey.liveserver: local server with auto-reload. 'Go Live' button in the status bar.
mtxr.sqltools: universal database client (MySQL/PG/SQLite/…). Has its own SQL formatter.
alexcvzz.vscode-sqlite: run SQLite queries right in the editor.
ms-vscode.vscode-node-azure-pack: 'Azure Tools' pack (pulls in the group below).
ms-dotnettools.vscode-dotnet-runtime: installs the .NET runtime automatically (a dependency of the Azure extensions).
eamodio.gitlens: blame, history, comparisons, graphs. Ctrl+Shift+G → GitLens tabs.
mhutchie.git-graph: visual commit graph. Ctrl+Shift+P → Git Graph: View.
donjayamanne.githistory: file/branch history and revision comparison in a tab.
github.vscode-pull-request-github: GitHub pull requests and issues right in the editor.
github.vscode-github-actions: view and run GitHub Actions workflows, run statuses.
waderyan.gitblame: author and commit of the current line in the status bar.
codezombiech.gitignore: .gitignore templates for a language/stack in one command.
gruntfuggly.todo-tree: tree of TODO/FIXME across the project. Configured in settings.json (icons/colors).
alefragnani.bookmarks: bookmarks in code. Ctrl+Alt+K — set, Ctrl+Alt+L/J — jump.
cardinal90.multi-cursor-case-preserve: keeps letter case when replacing with multiple cursors.
usernamehw.errorlens: shows errors and warnings inline. Configured in settings.json.
streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker: spell checking in code and comments.
adpyke.codesnap: beautiful code screenshots. Select code → CodeSnap.
ms-edgedevtools.vscode-edge-devtools: Edge DevTools inside VS Code (DOM inspector, network). Logs a harmless 'Failed to load message bundle'.
bierner.markdown-mermaid: renders mermaid diagrams in the Markdown preview.
formulahendry.code-runner: run a snippet in many languages. Ctrl+Alt+N.
llvm-vs-code-extensions.vscode-clangd: clangd: code intelligence, go to definition, clang-tidy right in the editor. Lighter than cpptools; needs compile_commands.json or .clangd.
jeff-hykin.better-cpp-syntax: accurate highlighting for modern C++ (templates, lambdas, concepts).
cschlosser.doxdocgen: generates a Doxygen comment for a function on /** + Enter.
mesonbuild.mesonbuild: highlighting and builds for Meson projects.
matepek.vscode-catch2-test-adapter: GoogleTest/Catch2/doctest tests in the Testing panel: run and debug one by one.
ms-vscode.hexeditor: hex editor for binary files (dumps, build outputs).
